plans.name: Partial capture for five
plans.idea: The capture endpoint may forward a client-supplied amount to PayPal, or accept any COMPLETED capture without comparing the captured amount and final_capture flag with the shop order's $245 total.

plans.name: Cheap capture, costly order
plans.idea: The capture handler may trust a shop-order identifier supplied in the request body or query string instead of using the shop order permanently bound to the PayPal order being captured.

plans.name: Planted capture collision
plans.idea: Order creation may let the shopper control custom_id or reference_id. Planting a new five-item order under the legitimate order's identifier may make the shop resolve the genuinely signed $49 capture webhook to the newest matching order, even though that capture ID was already used for the original

plans.name: Duplicate lines, single charge
plans.idea: Pricing or PayPal-order creation may deduplicate repeated SKUs with a map or first-line lookup, while fulfillment retains every raw duplicate line from the submitted bag.

plans.name: Yen amount, dollar basket
plans.idea: Create-order handling may forward shopper-supplied currency or purchase_units to PayPal while recording the basket internally in USD, then compare only the numeric capture value and ignore its currency during capture verification.

plans.name: Declined card, injected paid state
plans.idea: The card checkout may construct its order from the submitted body, or honor paid/status/capture fields, before applying the card gateway's declined result. Referencing the already completed legitimate capture may make the new order appear settled.
